question: In January 2023, the legislative bill providing ________ reservation to women in state government jobs has been approved by Uttarakhand Governor, Lt Gen (Retd.) Gurmit Singh.
solution:
The correct answer is __**30%.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• A **legislative bill** providing **reservation to women** in state government jobs has been approved by **Uttarakhand Governor**, Lt Gen (Retd.) **Gurmit Singh** in **January 2023.**
 
• **30% reservation** has been approved for women in state government jobs in **Uttarakhand.**
 
• According to the **Uttarakhand Public Services** (Horizontal Reservation for Women) **Bill 2022**, women candidates who permanently reside in Uttarakhand will be given preference for **30% of open positions** in public services and posts after** July 24, 2006, **with** 20%** of the vacancies being filled through **horizontal reservation.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Reservation **refers to the policy of reserving a certain percentage of seats or positions in **government jobs, educational institutions, **and other areas for certain groups of people who have been historically **disadvantaged or discriminated against**.
 
• In India, **reservation policies** are used to address historical inequalities based on **caste, tribe, gender, **and other factors.
 
• **Women's reservation** in government jobs has been a long-standing demand in India, as women have historically been underrepresented in the public sector workforce.
 
• The approval of this legislative bill in Uttarakhand is a significant step towards increasing** women's representation** and participation in the state government workforce.
